date_note: Date is the IT Daily publication day; the page gives no survey date or earlier day.
title: Bitkom survey: 55 percent of internet users in Germany have been notified that their data was in a leak
summary: IT Daily reports a representative survey by Bitkom Research for the digital association Bitkom of internet users in Germany. According to the report, 55 percent of internet users in Germany have at some point been notified that their personal data was affected by a data leak.
plain: A German industry survey says 55 percent of internet users have been told their data was in a leak.
exec: A Bitkom survey, as reported by IT Daily, says 55 percent of German internet users were notified of a data leak.

evidence.quote: 55 Prozent der Internetnutzerinnen und -nutzer in Deutschland wurden schon einmal benachrichtigt
Das zeigt eine repräsentative Umfrage von Bitkom Research im Auftrag des Digitalverbands Bitkom

validation.note: Only IT Daily read; Bitkom's own release was not read.
